_comment: Every string hmo-updater.exe can draw. This file is the source; scripts/build-updater.js generates the C# table from it (non-ASCII escaped as \uXXXX, so no codepage question ever reaches csc), which means the helper needs no file at runtime and a missing or hand-edited JSON cannot strand a user mid-update. test/updater-strings.test.js asserts the two tables have the same keys and the same {placeholders}, and that every key the C# sources ask for exists here.

en.error.timeoutHint: If the app does not come back by itself, download the installer and run it.
